# Workshop Code

Use the Texas-calibrated datasets from the [Data page](data.html) with the
[Hands-on R Lab](workshop.html).

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Lab R script](code/workshop_lab.R) | Yaosheng's script for the live lab, covering traditional DID, TWFE, an event study, and CSA group-by-time, group-specific, calendar, Simple ATT, and dynamic estimates. |
| [R Markdown source](workshop.Rmd) | Optional download with the explanations and executable code for the Workshop page. |

## Run the Lab

[Install R and the packages](workshop.html#set-up-packages) before the session.
Download both dataset CSVs from the [Data page](data.html) into your R project folder,
then run the Lab R script from that folder.
